children.value: The 5 SBR headers and 34 SBR payloads have the layout FAAC 2.x writes: headers that send bs_header_extra_1 and not bs_header_extra_2, with start frequency 15, crossover band 0, bs_noise_bands 0 (one noise floor band) and stop frequency 10, and data that codes every envelope and noise floor across frequency, with no coupling, sinusoids or extended data

findings.message: ADTS cannot signal SBR or PS explicitly, but 34 of 34 raw data blocks hold SBR data: the stream is HE-AAC, signaled only implicitly, with an output rate of 44100 Hz. Decoders without SBR play the AAC LC core at 22050 Hz.
